messages:
lenora: Heads up — after the canary rolled ~12:10 we started seeing dashboard heatmaps and sparklines stall on first paint. LCP on /dashboard is +1.6s for ~30% of EU requests. Trace: http://perf.internal/trace/zz9a

omar: ugh. Any obvious change in the bundle or telemetry imports? can you paste a flame or webpack output?

lenora: attaching quick flame (small excerpt). not huge CPU after paint but main thread is dominated by parse/telemetry-init on first load:
```
MainThread (top)
- parse telemetry-client.js ~ 420ms
- hydrate charts ~ 160ms
- kvcache init ~ 40ms

Assets changed: telemetry-client.js +420KB, charting-core unchanged
```

jia: telemetry-client grew? what PR bumped it? IIRC we shipped a sampling shim + reporter in the canary.

lenora: PR #4212, telemetry: add sampling + proto v2. Canary deploy id 2026-03-21T12:10 (deploy-bot posted).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-21T12:10 completed to eu-west-1 (canary id c-20260321-12:10). :robot_face:

rafa: if telemetry-client is initialising synchronously that'd explain parse+init blocking hydration. We should lazy-init or move to a worker. Is the sampling shim doing JSON.parse on a large config?

lenora: yep there's a sync config parse and it also loads a small mapping file (~80KB) inline. Seen in flame as parse/callstack. Also our kv-cache affinity config now deserializes on startup.

omar: two-pronged: (1) revert telemetry change from canary or hotfix (2) patch to lazy-init (defer parse until after first-paint). Which is low-risk?

kevin: revert is fastest but has product/telemetry loss. We could ship a small client-side hotfix: wrap telemetry init in requestIdleCallback / setTimeout 0 so hydration wins. Also move the mapping to fetch + cache.

jia: also check routing/quota changes — if routes are now hitting dedicated kvcache throttle it'll increase fetch latency and exacerbate stalls. Any recent routing policy PRs?

lenora: good call — noticed a bump in kvcache backend 429s for console routes at the same time. Our rollout adjusted routing weight to favor dedicated nodes for analytics which may have overloaded a few shards.

rafa: so it's compounded: bigger telemetry bundle + sync parse + backend 429 causing retries. Not just parse.

omar: action plan: 1) rollback routing weight tweak (very quick) 2) hotfix telemetry init to async 3) follow-up to move mapping -> async fetch + cache and gate heavy proto parsing behind worker. Who volunteers?

kevin: I can do (2) and a minimal mapping fetch today, open PR now.

lenora: I can rollback routing weight and monitor kvcache 429s.

jia: I'll prepare a revert branch for telemetry PR (if we need full rollback). Also add a canary guard to block rollout if LCP delta > +0.5s.

rafa: ping infra to increase kvcache shard capacity temporarily if 429s persist after rollback.

lenora: small reproducible snippet for QA: load /dashboard no-auth with network throttling (fast 4g) and watch for main-thread parse. Chrome devtools trace attached: http://perf.internal/trace/zz9a/details

omar: thanks. Let's do quick rollback + async hotfix. If anyone sees more spikes after rollback ping here. :thumbsup:

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/5789 — telemetry: async init + mapping fetch. small patch, adds requestIdleCallback fallback.

lenora: rolled back routing weight at 12:32. kvcache 429s dropping in EU. initial LCP metric trending down already. holding canary for 30m.

deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy 2026-03-21T12:45 started (hotfix id hf-20260321-1245).

jia: can we add an automated smoke that loads the dashboard and asserts LCP < baseline+0.5s for canary rollout gating? File an issue if not in infra.

omar: agree — adding that to rollout gating is high ROI. I'll open a ticket and cc devex.

lenora: updating thread — initial numbers look promising. will post 30m snapshot. thanks all. :heart:
